body:
Cloudflare error 1020 explained

When Cloudflare blocks you, it returns a page titled Attention Required! | Cloudflare containing cf-error-details and the text "Sorry, you have been blocked". Look for the Cloudflare Ray ID to report it.
note: A normal allowed 200 article that explains/quotes the Cloudflare block-page markers, served behind Cloudflare. The block detector must NOT flag it: the non-2xx status gate is what saves it. FP guard.
